# AirNet

AirNet is a local-first network diagnostics tool. A single measurement reports latency,
jitter, loss, DNS/TCP/TLS/TTFB timing, IPv4/IPv6 balance, proxy/VPN interference and an
optional bandwidth pass. It does not install a driver, run a background service, create an
account, or upload measurements.

Repository: https://github.com/RyzenWang/AirNet
License: MIT

## Use it from an agent

Prefer the headless CLI. It never opens a window and never persists a history record.

```bash
airnet-cli scan --json                 # one ProbeJson object on stdout
airnet-cli scan --json result.json     # write one object to a file
airnet-cli scan --bandwidth            # add a 4 s download + 4 MB upload pass
airnet-cli watch --json --interval 10  # one compact ProbeJson line per cycle (NDJSON)
airnet-cli history --json --limit 10   # local history, newest first
airnet-cli version
```

Exit codes for `scan`: 0 healthy (>= 90), 1 fair (>= 75), 2 poor (>= 60),
3 failed or an unhandled error. `watch --json` emits one object per line and runs until
SIGINT unless `--count N` is supplied.

The JSON is additive schema version 1. Read `latency.averageMs`, `latency.jitterMs`,
`latency.lossPercent`, `downloadMbps`, `uploadMbps`, `score`, `grade`, `verdict`,
`timing`, `dualStack`, `interface`, `interference`, `dns` and `findings`.

## Safety rules for agents

- Do not run privileged commands, change DNS, change the system proxy, edit hosts, or
  install drivers. AirNet can propose those actions; a human must approve them.
- Use `--bandwidth` only when the user explicitly asks for a bandwidth test; it uploads
  about 4 MB.
- `scan` and `watch` do not write history. Do not claim they did.
- Do not invent values when a probe is blocked. Treat missing/zero bandwidth as
  "not measured", not as 0 Mbps.
- Treat measured IPs, SSIDs and hostnames as private user data.

## Source map

- `src/AirNet.Core` — measurement, diagnosis, JSON, history
- `src/AirNet.Cli` — headless commands
- `src/AirNet.App` — Avalonia desktop UI
- `docs/AGENT.md` — detailed agent notes
